sources.description: NVIDIA technical blog on Palantir Foundry supply-chain implementation

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $1.935B, up 93% year over year; GAAP operating income was $0.912B at a 47% margin.
counter_evidence: Quarterly growth is unusually high and may normalize; quarter-end seasonality and large deals make extrapolation unsafe.

claims.claim: U.S. commercial Q2 revenue grew 149% year over year to $764M; U.S. commercial RDV reached $6.238B, up 124%.
counter_evidence: RDV includes contractual structures and is not equivalent to non-cancelable GAAP remaining performance obligations.

claims.claim: H1 2026 OCF was $2.115B, PPE purchases $0.022B and SBC $0.467B.
counter_evidence: OCF benefited from contract-liability inflows while accounts receivable consumed cash; period timing matters.

claims.claim: OCF-PPE-SBC owner-cash proxy was $1.627B in H1 2026 versus $0.520B in H1 2025, with proxy margin improving to 45.6% from 27.6%.
counter_evidence: The proxy is not distributable cash and not a direct incremental-ROIC measurement.

claims.claim: No customer exceeded 10% of H1 2026 revenue; the top three represented 16% of revenue.
counter_evidence: One customer represented 27% of accounts receivable, and U.S. customers represented 80% of H1 revenue, so concentration risk has not disappeared.

claims.claim: At June 30, Palantir had $2.030B cash, $7.379B marketable securities and no drawn balance on its $500M revolver.
counter_evidence: A portion of marketable securities consists of public equity holdings; all liquidity is not equivalent to operating cash.

claims.claim: SBC expense rose 48% year over year in H1 2026 to $466.8M, while SBC/revenue fell to roughly 13.1% from 16.7%.
counter_evidence: Absolute SBC and outstanding option/RSU/SAR overhang remain large; relative improvement does not eliminate dilution.

claims.claim: NVIDIA publicly described use of Palantir Foundry in its own supply-chain decision-intelligence workflow and a customized Nemotron model lifecycle.
counter_evidence: No revenue, contract value or margin contribution from this use case was disclosed.

claims.claim: At a $165.86 reference price and a 2.569B diluted share proxy, the model requires about 28.8% revenue CAGR in years 2-10 under a 35% owner-cash margin and 22x terminal multiple.
counter_evidence: Reverse expectations are highly sensitive to margin, share count, discount rate and terminal assumptions; this is not the market's unique forecast.

claims.claim: Palantir's moat trajectory is strengthening, but valuation asymmetry remains insufficient for new-buy approval.
counter_evidence: A much larger and longer-duration AI software outcome could make today's price attractive; short-term operating momentum is exceptionally strong.

source_quality_notes: Financial statement claims use SEC and company IR primary sources.
NVIDIA evidence is treated as customer-value/product evidence only, not as undisclosed financial contribution.
The market price is a secondary reference quote and is explicitly not treated as exchange-audited.
Facts, calculations, estimates and opinions are separated; unknown incremental ROIC is not converted into false precision.
